environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy in both RC1 (2026-07-21) and RC2 (2026-07-22) — re-confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial each time via a live test fetch, not a one-off failure. All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; confidence scores calibrated accordingly. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography in this release — state/jurisdiction fields are free-text values, not district_id references. Wiring to Package001_Geography's geographic primary keys is future work (see acquisition_backlog.json). Future packages requiring education anchoring may in turn depend on this package.
